candidate_generation.global: 50 Dirichlet(1,...,1) samples per building per pool
candidate_generation.local: 50 convex perturbations around the 100 lowest-R initial rows per pool, alpha uniform [0.10,0.25]

selection: each model selects its lowest predicted_mean from that round's shared pool; ties by candidate_id
test_protocol: after each model's 5 rounds, refit on the initial 2048 plus its own five results; then generate and predict a separate 100-point test set before solver labels are obtained
trajectories: each model receives only its own solver feedback
